focus.title: US CPI (Sep)
story_so_far: August CPI surprised hot at 3.35% y/y
The Fed hiked in September — and the minutes said 'most' saw another hike by year-end
Then payrolls collapsed to +29k and took an October hike off the table
focus.stakes: Decides whether an October hike comes back to life.

forks.then: Disinflation story holds — Dec odds slip, crowded USD longs get room to unwind.
Status quo — Dec stays the base case, USD keeps its bid near 18-month highs.
October is live again — front-end reprices hard, DXY makes fresh highs.

watch: 7:30 AM CT — the print: core m/m first, headline y/y second
7:35–8:00 AM CT — FedWatch Oct/Dec odds and the 2y yield
USD/JPY near 159–160 — intervention risk if USD spikes

recap.outcome: Core came in at 0.4% m/m — hot. October is back on the table.

thesis.note: The hawkish-Fed chapter holds: sticky inflation outweighs the payrolls scare, and the dollar's bid has fresh fuel.

items.headline: CPI hot: core 0.4% m/m vs 0.3% expected, headline 3.9% y/y
bullets: FX: USD jumps across the board; USD/JPY tags 159.40 within a minute.
Numbers: Headline 3.9% y/y (exp 3.7%), core 0.4% m/m (exp 0.3%). Shelter and services ex-housing led.

items.headline: October hike odds jump to ~48% on FedWatch
bullets: FX: DXY through 102.60 — a fresh 18-month high.
Meaning: The tiebreaker broke hawkish — the payrolls miss is being read as noise against sticky prices.

items.headline: 2y yield +14bp to 4.92%; EUR/USD loses 1.1161 support
bullets: FX: EUR/USD 1.1142 — the 1.1065 magnet from the euro chapter is now in play.

items.headline: Japan's finance ministry: watching FX moves 'with a sense of urgency'
bullets: FX: USD/JPY eases to 158.90 off the jawboning.
Meaning: Verbal intervention at 159.40 marks the line Tokyo is defending.
